name: @fhold/electron
description: Optional static desktop administration tool for fhold stacks
author: fhold contributors

scripts.bundle: bun run scripts/generate-icon.mjs && bun build src/admin-main.ts --bundle --target=node --outfile dist/admin-main.js --external electron && bun build src/admin-preload.ts --bundle --target=node --format=cjs --outfile dist/admin-preload.cjs --external electron && bun run scripts/stage-assets.ts
scripts.bundle:e2e: bun run bundle && bun build src/admin-e2e.ts --bundle --target=node --outfile dist/admin-e2e.js --external electron
